groups.label: Actions
groups.description: Controls that let people trigger, toggle, or confirm an action.

groups.label: Forms & Inputs
groups.description: Controls for entering, choosing, validating, and submitting values.

groups.label: Navigation
groups.description: Components that help people move between destinations, views, or command sets.

groups.label: Layout & Structure
groups.description: Building blocks for page structure, surfaces, spacing, and resizable regions.

groups.label: Content & Media
groups.description: Components for text, code, imagery, icons, and visual content.

groups.label: Feedback & Status
groups.description: Components that communicate loading, progress, confirmation, and transient status.

groups.label: Overlays & Disclosure
groups.description: Components that reveal, focus, or temporarily layer additional information and choices.

groups.label: Collections & Browsing
groups.description: Components for browsing or choosing within visual and selectable collections.

groups.label: Accessibility & Utilities
groups.description: Support primitives used to preserve accessibility, rendering, and presence behavior.
